name: context-health
description: Check whether Codex project tasks still have trustworthy, focused context.

interface.shortDescription: Detect drift and overloaded project tasks.
interface.longDescription: Scans all Codex tasks in a project for drift, repeated failures, stale assumptions, and excessive context load, then shows an explainable refreshable dashboard.
